integrity: Finite computations and the independently formulated structural induction are distinguished; no independent verification is asserted.
limitations: This theorem applies to a cycle with one attached path only, not all unicyclic or all connected graphs. Enumeration provides finite checks, while the all-parameter assertion follows from exact transfer identities and induction. Historical priority requires independent confirmation.
title: Exact perfect-edge-domination counts and a strict cycle bound for lollipop graphs
